extraction.placeName: U-Bahn-Abstellgleis zwischen U-Bahnhof Kochstraße und U-Bahnhof Hallesches Tor
extraction.summaryEn: Police arrested two suspects after a group was seen spraying graffiti on subway cars on a siding between Kochstraße and Hallesches Tor stations overnight. Four others fled, and spray cans were seized.
